head: WORKTREE
summary: Saga use case, inbox, listener, outbox commands and optimistic-locking update are correct and well tested; transition, inbox and outbox share one transaction. B1 uses a ledger test double, which is allowed by the brief but does not itself show money moving; the PR must state that.

acceptance_criteria.evidence: PaymentSagaIT#paymentIsCompletedThroughTheSaga asserts statuses and the ReserveFunds/PostTransfer contents (debtor, creditor, amount, currency) on real Kafka; money movement for those commands is proven in ledger-service, not in this IT (design-note choice).
PaymentSagaIT#refusedReservationRejectsThePayment: REJECTED with 'INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS: ...' and only the ReserveFunds command sent.
PaymentSagaIT#transitionLosingTheOptimisticLockCommitsNothing (no status, command or inbox row); PaymentPersistenceAdapter.update on the managed entity with @Version.

findings.description: B1 says the debtor is debited and the creditor credited, but no test in this task ties payment-service's commands to a ledger consuming them; only the Avro contract links the two sides.
findings.suggestion: State the trade-off in the PR as the brief requires; consider a later cross-service smoke test.

findings.description: The new reject-reason format '<RefusalReason>: <detail>' is now visible through GET /payments/{id} but is not described in the OpenAPI reason field or an ADR.
findings.suggestion: Document the format in the OpenAPI description of reason.
